description: If every function graph is provably total and unique at its stage, a finite definition chain preserves and reflects native derivability of every initial-language sentence under the composite inclusion.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DefinitionalExtensions.tower_derives_iff.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  {K : ℕ → FirstOrder.Language}
  (d :
    (i : ℕ) →
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DefinitionalExtensions.DefinitionPackage
        (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DefinitionalExtensions.towerLanguage L K i) (K i))
  (T : L.Theory) (n : ℕ)
  (hd :
    ∀ i < n,
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DefinitionalExtensions.Admissible (d i)
        (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DefinitionalExtensions.towerTheory d T i))
  (A : L.Sentence) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Derives
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DefinitionalExtensions.towerTheory d T n)
      ((Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DefinitionalExtensions.towerMap n).onSentence A) ↔
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Derives T A
